name: image-generator
description: Cloudflare-based image generation app using Midjourney API

scripts.r2:create: wrangler r2 bucket create midjourney-images && wrangler r2 bucket create midjourney-images-preview
scripts.r2:lifecycle: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle put midjourney-images --config r2-lifecycle-config.json && wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle put midjourney-images-preview --config r2-lifecycle-config.json
